toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two main clauses here (an imperative clause and 'jy kry'), so a comma goes before it.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS 2017 comma before 'en' joining two main clauses (the imperative 'Sit daardie twee dinge agter mekaar' and 'jy kry 'n ry van drie').
toegepas.rede_keurder: Both sides are full main clauses with their own finite verb, so the AWS comma belongs before 'en'; the wording and meaning are unchanged.

laat_vaar.blok: Die dier kry dit deur te eet
laat_vaar.voor: Die energie in daardie blare gaan so oor na die bok.
laat_vaar.na: So gaan die energie in daardie blare oor na die bok.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Fronting 'So' reads more naturally than 'so' wedged inside the separable verb 'gaan ... oor'; meaning unchanged.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The original 'gaan so oor na die bok' is natural Afrikaans; fronting 'So' is a lateral move and can also read as a conclusion ('therefore') rather than 'in this way'.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Tussen die son en die plant gee die son se lig die energie.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Tussen die son en die plant is dit die son se lig wat die energie gee.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: With subject-verb inversion the sentence can be misread as giving the light the energy; the cleft makes clear the light is the giver.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: After the inversion the light is the only possible subject, so the original is clear and the cleft only makes it longer.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'weer' suggests something is done again, which does not fit; 'nooit terug nie' says what is meant.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'weer terug' is a normal Afrikaans fixed pairing meaning 'back', not 'again', so the proposal is a lateral move.
